name: VWO Testing
description: VWO Testing and Feature Management support feature flags, experiments, campaigns, rollouts, environments, targeting rules, and optimization workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a restricted personal API token bound to one non-production workspace. Relay approval-gates bounded feature flag metadata reads while environment states, rules, targeting, variations, values, SDK keys, campaigns, evaluation, tracking, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: VWO_TESTING_PERSONAL_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: VWO Testing personal API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated VWO user restricted to read the selected workspace.

credentialRequirements.name: VWO_TESTING_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: VWO Testing workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production numeric workspace.

capabilities.label: Read feature flag metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded workspace feature flag metadata with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read VWO Testing feature flags
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded workspace feature flag metadata.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Personal API tokens, SDK keys, and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read targeting or evaluation data
blocked.description: Environment states, rules, targeting, segments, audiences, variations, variable values, SDK keys, users, campaigns, results, and tracking data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate VWO
blocked.description: Feature flag, rule, environment, campaign, project, audience, variation, token, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only first-page workspace feature flag list and exact GETs run on app.vwo.com with stored workspace binding; campaign management, arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, evaluation, tracking, and alternate origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; restricted authority, fixed VWO/workspace routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/tracking/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; restricted authority, fixed VWO/workspace routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/tracking/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted restricted token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted restricted token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: VWO Testing requires a customer account, restricted user/personal API token, and one workspace. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted staging user/token outside this worker, configure token and workspace ID in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: VWO's official Feature Management reference pins the workspace feature list, account binding, limit/offset controls, token authentication, and separate mutation operations.
VWO's official reference pins exact feature flag reads by ID inside a fixed workspace.
VWO documents REST control of A/B, feature test, and feature rollout resources, which Relay deliberately does not mutate or evaluate.
